stablecoinCount.description: Total number of stablecoins deployed by this factory.

getDeployedStablecoin.description: Read the on-chain record for a stablecoinId: issuer plus the deployed cluster addresses (token, compliance, identity registry, reserve oracle, access manager, timelock) and deploy metadata.

implementations.description: The implementation/logic addresses the factory clones per stablecoin (identity registry, reserve oracle, compliance, token).

issuerRegistry.description: Address of the shared IssuerRegistry the factory checks before allowing a deployment (only approved issuers may deploy). Same registry as the real-estate factory.

tokenRegistry.description: Address of the shared multi-factory TokenRegistry each newly deployed stablecoin is registered into.

authority.description: Address of the PlatformAccessManager that controls who may call restricted functions.

upgradeAuthority.description: Address authorized to upgrade this factory's UUPS implementation. Read-only for visibility; changing it is a governance action handled elsewhere.

isPaused.description: Returns true if the factory is paused. While paused, createStablecoin reverts.

pauseFactory.description: Halt new stablecoin deployments. createStablecoin reverts until the factory is unpaused. Provide a reason for the audit log.

unpauseFactory.description: Resume stablecoin deployments after a pause.
